notes.title: 📢 Update 1.4.92 — Original Set Information for Zeptocosmos
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.4.92 — Original Set Information for Zeptocosmos[/b]

[b]What’s new:[/b]  
- Added [b]Original Set[/b] information in the [b]Level Info[/b] tab, accessible from the menu options while playing, for puzzles originally created by Aymeric.  
- This helps you identify puzzles from Aymeric’s collections, even though they have been sorted by difficulty and redistributed across new stages in Sokoboxes Duo.  
- Updated the [b]About[/b] section to display [b]Version: 1.4.92[/b].

[b]About Zeptocosmos:[/b]  
Zeptocosmos is a special collection of 40 exclusive puzzles created by Aymeric. For Sokoboxes Duo, these puzzles — along with others from Aymeric’s sets — were reorganized by difficulty and distributed into new stages with different names to fit the game’s design.  
This update makes it easy to check the puzzle’s original source: simply open the menu options during a level and look under the [b]Level Info[/b] tab for the [b]Original Set[/b] label.

[b]Zeptocosmos puzzles appear in these stages and numbers:[/b]

[list]  
[*][b]Venus:[/b] 34, 35, 36, 37  
[*][b]Earth:[/b] 27, 28, 29, 30  
[*][b]Moon:[/b] 33, 34, 35, 36, 37  
[*][b]Mars:[/b] 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38  
[*][b]Jupiter:[/b] 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21  
[*][b]Saturn:[/b] 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18  
[*][b]Uranus:[/b] 13, 14, 15, 16  
[*][b]Neptune:[/b] 2, 3  
[/list]

Use the [b]Original Set[/b] info in [b]Level Info[/b] to confirm you’re playing a [b]Zeptocosmos[/b] puzzle and enjoy this exclusive collection!
